hypotheses.R1_top8_beats_next8: At layer 4, the absolute median removal target projection of ranks 1-8 is at least 1.25 times ranks 9-16 on both corpora.
hypotheses.R2_more_local_edges_add_downstream_effec: At layer 4, top-64 removal target projection is at least top-8 on both corpora.
hypotheses.R3_local_rank_bands_predict_downstream_b: Across records, layers 3-5, and the four disjoint rank bands, local projection correlates at least 0.50 with downstream removal projection on both corpora.
hypotheses.R4_edited_source_explains_top8: At layer 4, edited-source-only top-8 reaches at least 80% of the global top-8 absolute removal projection on both corpora.
hypotheses.R5_propagated_sources_are_causal: Non-edited-source top-8 reaches at least 0.05 removal target projection in the same layer on both corpora.
hypotheses.R6_top64_is_a_major_route: Top-64 reaches at least 0.25 removal target projection in the same layer on both corpora.
hypotheses.R7_larger_route_stabilizes_cross_world_p: Top-64 insertion and removal projections correlate at least 0.70 across records and layers on both corpora.
